name: Heartwood Jab
description: Drive a fist hardened like heartwood straight into the opponent's breastbone.

name: Lichen Skin
description: Spread a clinging crust of green qi over the skin that dulls cuts and slows hands.

name: Branch Hop
description: Push off a grown limb of qi to leap two bodies' lengths to the side.

name: Cambium Warmth
description: Wake the living layer under an ally's skin with warm qi so cuts and bruises begin to close.

name: Strangler Vine
description: Wind a thick vine around the opponent's chest and squeeze tighter with each breath they take.

name: Splinterfall
description: Shatter a limb of qi overhead so a rain of sharp splinters falls on the opponent.

name: Timber Fall
description: Topple a whole trunk of qi onto the opponent with a crushing weight that cracks stone and bone.

name: Sentinel Bark
description: Wrap the body in thick bark that regrows over each crack as the blows land.

name: Bark Rebuff
description: Meet a strike with a hard rough forearm and throw the weapon wide.

name: Knot Brace
description: Clench the torso around a hard knot of qi at the ribs to absorb a body blow.

name: Gnarl Fist
description: Punch with a fist twisted and hardened like a gnarled root burl.

name: Sapwood Lift
description: Raise sap qi in an ally's legs and back so a heavy burden or a hard guard feels lighter.

name: Layered Bark
description: Stack several overlapping plates of bark qi so each blow strips only one layer.

name: Thornback Return
description: Raise thorns along the back and arms that drive into whoever strikes them and send the pain back.

name: Ironwood Mantle
description: Cloak the whole body in a dense mantle of ironwood qi that turns blades and bruising blows.

name: Thornmirror
description: Meet a heavy strike with a flowering sheet of thorns that hurls the force back at the attacker.

name: Timber Rap
description: Rap a knuckle of hard qi against the nerve points of the opponent's arm to numb it.

name: Pith Sense
description: Send a thin thread of qi into an ally's body to read injuries and fading life through it.

name: Sapwood Cradle
description: Hold an injured ally in a soft cradle of warm qi that holds the pain and steadies the pulse.

name: Burl Guard
description: Swell a hard burl of qi at the forearm or shoulder to take a sudden hit.

name: Heartwood Surge
description: Send deep warm qi from the core of the body into an ally to knit broken bone and torn muscle.

name: Cambium Purge
description: Flush taint and lingering poison out of an ally's blood through the skin with clean green qi.

name: Splintering Cut
description: Draw a wedge of hardened qi down the opponent's guard to splinter it along the grain.

name: Sapbreath
description: Force sap qi through the heart of one whose breath has just stopped to restart pulse and breath within moments.

name: Evergreen Mend
description: Pour undying green qi into a gravely hurt ally to close deep wounds and restore lost blood.

name: Rootnet Pulse
description: Send a slow pulse of qi through the ground roots and feel every footfall in the area.

name: Taproot Pierce
description: Drive a hard taproot of qi up from the ground through the opponent's lead foot.

name: Root Glide
description: Skim along the ground on a thread of root qi to land at the opponent's side.

name: Rootweb Brace
description: Spread a web of fine roots under the feet that spreads a heavy blow across the earth.

name: Webbed Root
description: Raise a tangled web of roots round the opponent's legs that tightens each time they pull.

name: Rootbite
description: Snap a row of tough root teeth up from the ground to bite the opponent's legs.

name: Root Tide
description: Heave a rolling wave of roots from the ground that sweeps over everyone in front of the user.

name: Shared Roots
description: Join the roots of several allies through the ground so strength and breath pass freely between them.

name: Twin Bough
description: Swing two matched limbs of qi together from either side to catch the opponent between them.

name: Twin Bark
description: Cross both forearms behind twin screens of bark qi that back one another.

name: Double Twig
description: Stab a pair of hard twigs of qi side by side into one spot in the opponent's guard.

name: Twin Spring
description: Take two quick matched steps on springing qi and end on the opposite flank.

name: Matched Lash
description: Crack two long vines from both hands in turn so the second follows the first before it can be guarded.

name: Bough Pincer
description: Close two heavy limbs of qi from either side about the opponent's body and lock them shut.

name: Paired Mend
description: Heal two allies at once by running sap qi through the user from one to the other.

name: Twintimber
description: Bring both great limbs down together on the opponent so the two blows land as a single crushing one.

name: Twin Canopy
description: Spread two overlapping crowns of dense leaves over the user and nearby allies to ward off falling blows.

name: Low Root
description: Gather qi low in the body like water in a basin and let it rise against the blow.

name: Cooling Sap
description: Run a cool stream of sap qi from the user's palm into an ally's wound to ease and close it.

name: Stream Sprout
description: Skip lightly over the ground on sprouts of qi that rise and fall with each pace.

name: Current Sense
description: Follow the flow of sap through nearby trees and plants to feel what has moved among them.

name: Sapflow Surge
description: Run rushing sap qi through an ally's body to quicken the limbs and clear the head.

name: Leaf Overflow
description: Let the stored qi brim over in a rush of leaves and water that batters those near the user.

name: Overflow Bloom
description: Burst the gathered qi into a great bloom of razor petals that cuts across a wide arc.

name: Healing Cradle
description: Raise a wide tree of healing qi over several wounded allies and let its sap run into each of them.

name: Elm Strike
description: Bring a flat hard palm like an elm limb down onto the opponent's shoulder.

name: Perch Hold
description: Grip the ground with toes of qi and hold the stance against a push from above.

name: Elm Glide
description: Drop from a raised limb of qi and glide down to land lightly behind the opponent.

name: Hawk Sprig
description: Hurl a sharp sprig of qi like a falling talon at the opponent's eyes.

name: Elm Snare
description: Drop a net of elm withes over the opponent that clamps their arms to the sides.

name: Talon Branch
description: Spear a hooked limb of qi from above through the opponent's guard to catch the flesh beneath.

name: Elm Plunge
description: Leap from the highest limb of qi and fall on the opponent with the full weight of the tree.

name: Snaring Roots
description: Plant hidden roots under the ground that rise and seize whoever steps over them.

name: Bent Switch
description: Bend a springy switch of qi back and release it across the opponent's guard.

name: Sworn Bark
description: Hold a steady layer of bark qi on the guard arm and take the blow without giving ground.

name: Swaying Pine
description: Sway the whole body at the waist like a tall pine and let the strike spend itself in air.

name: Sworn Step
description: Plant one rooted foot and swing the other round it to change facing without losing the stance.

name: Pine Whip
description: Whip a long needled bough of qi across the opponent's face and arms.

name: Needle Shower
description: Shake out a rain of pine needles hardened with qi that prick every part of the opponent.

name: Oathwood Lash
description: Bring a great whipping bough round in a flat arc that no guard can quite meet.

name: Pine Aegis
description: Raise a dense screen of interlocked pine boughs that stands against a long assault.

name: Oath Branch
description: Swing a hard limb of qi in a straight line at the opponent and hold that line to the end.

name: Stone Root
description: Wrap roots of qi into the rock beneath the feet and let a blow pass into the stone.

name: Lone Sprig
description: Cast a single sprig of hardened qi in a straight flat throw at the opponent's throat.

name: Rockgrip
description: Anchor an ally's stance with roots of qi through the soles so it holds against wind and shove.

name: Tree Anchor
description: Pin the opponent to the ground with a heavy root through each leg.

name: Open Bough
description: Spread a wide limb of qi and bring it across the opponent in a plain open sweep.

name: Resin Seal
description: Daub sticky resin qi across the opponent's chest to stop their qi flowing for a short while.

name: Oathtree Strike
description: Stand fast on the roots and bring a trunk-heavy blow straight down the line of the stance.

name: Oathtree Ring
description: Set a ring of trees of qi about the user that bars entry and strikes any who cross it.

name: Pine Needle
description: Thrust two stiff fingers of qi like a pine needle into a joint or nerve.

name: Bearing Root
description: Root the stance on one fixed line and let the guard hold to that line alone.

name: Pine Sway
description: Rock the body from the roots to turn a strike past and keep the stance whole.

name: Resin Salve
description: Spread thick healing resin qi over an ally's cut so it seals and keeps out taint.

name: Resin Bind
description: Smear sticky resin qi across the opponent's feet and hands until they hold fast.

name: Pine Lance
description: Drive a long straight lance of pine qi through the opponent's guard from a fixed stance.

name: Unbroken Pine
description: Stand as a tall pine that no blow can bend and hold the line against a gale of attacks.

name: Bearing Thrust
description: Drive a mighty pine-straight thrust along the held line through guard and body alike.
